# ScienceInsights

> > A science education platform covering biomedical engineering, analytical chemistry, environmental biology, and applied life sciences with evidence-based explanations.

ScienceInsights provides accessible scientific explanations across diverse topics including diagnostic technologies (MRI, GC-MS, LC-MS), biomedical engineering applications, environmental science, toxicology, and natural history. Content emphasizes practical applications of scientific principles with technical accuracy suitable for students, professionals, and curious learners.

## Key Topics

- Biomedical Engineering
- MRI Safety and Technology
- Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS)
- Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS)
- Drug Screening and Immunoassay
- Cross-Reactivity and False Positives
- Healthcare Technology and Medical Devices
- Tissue Engineering and Regenerative Medicine
- Environmental Biology
- Invasive Species Management
- Toxicology and Chemical Safety
- Biosafety and Laboratory Standards
- Microbiology Culture Methods
- Genetics and Inheritance Patterns

## Biomedical Science and Healthcare Technology

- [What Is Biomedical Science and Engineering?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-biomedical-science-and-engineering): Overview of biomedical engineering field covering MRI, biosensors & gene therapy
- [How Many MRIs Are Safe in a Year?](https://scienceinsights.org/how-many-mris-are-safe-in-a-year): Clarifies MRI safety: no radiation limits, gadolinium contrast considerations
- [How to Tell If a Molecule Is an Acid or Base](https://scienceinsights.org/how-to-tell-if-a-molecule-is-an-acid-or-base): Covers Arrhenius, Brønsted-Lowry & Lewis theories for acid-base ID

## Analytical Chemistry and Drug Testing

- [What Can Cause a False Positive for Cocaine on a Drug Test?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-can-cause-a-false-positive-for-cocaine-on-a-drug-test): Explains false positives in cocaine tests via GC-MS/LC-MS & cross-reactivity

## Microbiology and Laboratory Science

- [How Many BSL-4 Labs Are There in the US?](https://scienceinsights.org/how-many-bsl-4-labs-are-there-in-the-us): Details US BSL-4 labs operated by CDC, NIH for dangerous pathogen research
- [What Is Peptone and How Is It Used in Microbiology?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-peptone-and-how-is-it-used-in-microbiology): Explains peptone/tryptone use in E. coli & Salmonella culture media

## Environmental Biology and Invasive Species

- [Why Are Spotted Lanternflies Bad for the Environment?](https://scienceinsights.org/why-are-spotted-lanternflies-bad-for-the-environment): Documents Lycorma delicatula invasive impact on North American agriculture
- [Where Does the Kissing Bug Live and Hide?](https://scienceinsights.org/where-does-the-kissing-bug-live-and-hide): Maps triatomine bug habitats in Latin America; Chagas disease prevention
- [What Eats a Yellow Jacket? Its Natural Predators](https://scienceinsights.org/what-eats-a-yellow-jacket-its-natural-predators): Identifies yellow jacket predators: kingbirds, flickers, blue jays & mammals
- [Why Are There So Many Yellow Jackets?](https://scienceinsights.org/why-are-there-so-many-yellow-jackets): Explains yellow jacket population dynamics & seasonal colony development
- [Why Are the Gnats So Bad This Year?](https://scienceinsights.org/why-are-the-gnats-so-bad-this-year): Analyzes gnat population surges: fungus gnats, fruit flies & drain flies

## Toxicology and Chemical Safety

- [How Cyanide Occurs Naturally in the Environment](https://scienceinsights.org/how-cyanide-occurs-naturally-in-the-environment): Examines natural cyanide (HCN) sources via cyanogenic glycosides in plants
- [Do Snakes Hate Mothballs? The Truth About Snake Repellents](https://scienceinsights.org/do-snakes-hate-mothballs-the-truth-about-snake-repellents): Debunks mothball myths for snake control; covers EPA regulations & safety

## Genetics and Human Biology

- [If My Blood Type Is O Negative, What Are My Parents?](https://scienceinsights.org/if-my-blood-type-is-o-negative-what-are-my-parents): Details O negative inheritance via ABO system & Rh factor genetics

## Optional

- [What Is Dicalcium Phosphate and How Is It Used?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-dicalcium-phosphate-and-how-is-it-used): Explores dicalcium phosphate (CaHPO₄) uses in supplements & food additives
- [When Do Purple Martins Migrate South?](https://scienceinsights.org/when-do-purple-martins-migrate-south): Tracks Progne subis migration from North America to Brazil wintering grounds
- [Why Is the Dead Sea So Salty and Full of Minerals?](https://scienceinsights.org/why-is-the-dead-sea-so-salty-and-full-of-minerals): Explains Dead Sea hypersalinity via Jordan Rift Valley geology & evaporation
- [What Are Bearcats? Facts About the Binturong](https://scienceinsights.org/what-are-bearcats-facts-about-the-binturong): Profile of Arctictis binturong: Southeast Asian Viverridae species facts
- [What Is Marrow (the Vegetable) and How Do You Cook It?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-marrow-the-vegetable-and-how-do-you-cook-it): Guide to Cucurbita pepo marrow squash: nutrition & UK cooking methods
- [When Do Acorns Fall Off Trees?](https://scienceinsights.org/when-do-acorns-fall-off-trees): Details oak species (Quercus) acorn drop timing & mast year ecology
